1079624.note: Research ladder (HLTV → esportsbooks → betting lines) applied because no esportsbook posted a real two-sided price for this low-tier card: HLTV files it as bo3 (match 2399301) with FORZE Reload #90 vs LFO 10 on the event page; EGW's match page prints only the 1.8/1.8 no-market placeholder (rejected) but states Bo3 and the LFO 10 lineup (Jackinho, Sapec, dottie, flaw, tvs); Polymarket prices the same slot under the lineup's org-seeking tag "Sökerorg" at 88¢/16¢ (FORZE Reload 1.14x / Sökerorg 6.25x, $373.86 volume), roster-verified identical to LFO 10. LFO 10 is absent from the official Valve standings file of 2026-10-05 (checked against ValveSoftware/counter-strike_regional_standings on GitHub, newest file is still standings_global_2026_10_05.md) and unranked on HLTV's live team page (peak #170); HLTV's Valve-ranking (beta) page of 2026-10-12 lists LFO 10 at #170 with 765 Valve points — that page is HLTV's beta projection (includes unfinished events), not the official weekly file, so it is evidence, never an official-file entry.

1081112.note: No esportsbook or prediction market prices this card anywhere on the research trail (Polymarket's CCT Europe board carries 10 markets — none for this pairing; EGW's match page prints only a single 1.8 placeholder, no second side). The published probability therefore stays this board's own originated line from the official Valve points (Banda Chuya 801 vs 6666 923, standings_global_2026_10_05.md). Research cross-checks point the same way as the line — HLTV: 6666 is #80 on the world ranking while Banda Chuya is currently unranked (peak #162); recent official results: 6666 on a 5-match win streak (EGW form table) while Banda Chuya lost 3:13 to GenOne on 11/10 and 1:2 to HYPERSPIRIT on 08/10 (HLTV team pages). One counter-signal is published, not reconciled: EGW's proprietary team rating favours Banda Chuya 902 vs 515. EGW's rating is not a price and not an official ranking; the flag records the disagreement.

1081120.note: Polymarket opened a market for this card (cs2-mellre-pg5-2026-10-16, title states BO3) but the book is uninitialised: it prints 94¢ for mellren and 93¢ for Privateer Gaming (both sides above 90¢, sum $1.87 for a $1 pair) with $0.00 volume. Ingesting those numbers would invent a ~50/50 that no trader believes, so the prices are refused (see refusals). The row keeps its originated line from the official Valve points (mellren 932 vs Privateer 608) cross-checked on HLTV (#94 vs #226), and the series length is taken from the market title only.
